title: Bullinger Digital
notes: Correspondence of the Zurich reformer Heinrich Bullinger (1504-1575), about 12,000 letters to and from him dated 1523-1575, held mostly in the Staatsarchiv des Kantons Zuerich and the Zentralbibliothek Zuerich. Metadata, summaries and footnotes come from the printed HBBW edition; the letter texts come from the HBBW, other printed editions, the HBBW team's preparatory work and automatic handwriting recognition, and are published with facsimiles, normalised search forms, machine translation into English and linked named entities. The project ran 2020-2025 at the Institute of Computational Linguistics, University of Zurich (leaders Patricia Scheurer, Phillip B. Stroebel, Martin Volk; funded by the UZH Foundation); at its end in May 2025 the TEI-XML corpus was handed to the Staatsarchiv Zuerich, which now maintains the online search system. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Universität Zürich (Institut für Computerlinguistik); Staatsarchiv des Kantons Zürich
